calibration.near_boundary_definition: current actual clearance 0..20mm above the safety threshold
calibration.normal_basis: shared exact interval-margin action gradient at each source replay action
calibration.undefined_normal_handling: exclude only from normal projections; retain records and report counts
calibration.iso_low_scalar_definition: mean LearnedDir common-normal reference variance over valid near-boundary states, first equal-weight states per seed, then equal-weight the two training seeds
calibration.iso_low_scalar_scope: one global scalar; matches calibration-pool near-boundary average normal noise, not total trace or every state

random_aniso.direction_draw: independent uniform sphere, once per generated action, fixed through all flow quadrature points
random_aniso.q_rule: detached local-margin safety sigmoid times positive head-gradient cosine, invalid gradients disabled
random_aniso.required_reporting: measure actual reference eigenvalues and trace on identical common states; shared formula alone is not proof of matching learned-q distributions

energy_scaling: alpha_initial=0.02*reference_variance; energy_target=0.75/reference_variance; noise covariance and inverse-covariance path energy remain paired
